classes.label: Class B common stock
classes.pricedAsReason: Class B has no public trading market (FY2025 10-K: "There is no public trading market for our Class B common stock"); it has identical economic rights to Class A ("identical rights except with respect to voting, conversion and transfer rights and therefore share equally in our net income or losses") and converts into Class A on most transfers, so it is priced through the listed Class A line.

notes: Class A is listed on the NYSE as PINS. Class B is unlisted. The filings searched (FY2025 10-K, Q3 2026 10-Q, 2026 proxy) do not state the conversion ratio in words; pricing Class B at one Class A share rests on the equal per-share rights and on the diluted EPS calculation, which 'assumes the conversion of our Class B common stock to Class A common stock'. No preferred stock is outstanding. The Class A count is lower than at the 10-K cover date because of the March 2026 accelerated share repurchase.
